newsitem.title: USA: Sequana jumps after asthma discovery.
newsitem.headline: Sequana jumps after asthma discovery.

text.p: Shares of Sequana Therapeutics Inc surged in early trading on Wednesday after it said it discovered a gene responsible for asthma.

The discovery triggers a $2 million milestone payment from its partner Boehringer Ingelheim International GmbH, according to Lehman Brothers analyst Matthew Murray. It is the first discovery of the five expected from the collaboration.
Murray said in a report he expects that the company has learned from the 2.5 years it took to discover the first gene and subsequent discoveries will happen more quickly.
The discovery of a second gene would trigger another $2 million milestone payment and later discoveries would trigger $1 million payments.
